title: The fossil fuel comeback is here
hook_text: Fossil fuel infrastructure hits ten-year high
script:
The US is building more fossil fuel infrastructure than it has in a decade.
At the same time, renewable energy growth is slowing down.
Electricity demand is climbing faster than it has in more than ten years.
More data centers, factories, and electric vehicles are plugging into the grid.
A report by the Environmental Defense Fund and Atlas Public Policy revealed the surge.
Will your power bill go up because of this?
